result.summary: Found 1 critical content issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed instead of a proper section title.

issues.description: The section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the translated/rendered text (e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization string for 'home_feed.popular_title' is properly loaded and rendered, and add fallback text so raw keys never appear in the UI.
